# pbs_remote_namespaces (Data Source)

Lists the namespaces of a datastore on a remote: PBS signs in to the remote with its credentials and lists the namespaces of the datastore its `auth_id` may see there, the root namespace among them. Like `pbs_remote_datastores`, reading it fails when the remote cannot be reached, refuses the credentials, or has no such datastore. Needs `Remote.Audit` on `/remote/<remote>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_remote_namespaces" "offsite" {
  remote = "offsite"
  store  = "archive"
}

# One pull job for each top-level namespace of the offsite datastore archive,
# each into a namespace of the same name in store1, so that each runs on its
# own schedule and may fail on its own. The root namespace is listed as an
# empty string, which the filter leaves out.
resource "pbs_sync_job" "archive" {
  for_each = toset([
    for n in data.pbs_remote_namespaces.offsite.namespaces : n.ns
    if n.ns != "" && !strcontains(n.ns, "/")
  ])

  id           = "pull-archive-${each.key}"
  store        = "store1"
  ns           = each.key
  remote       = "offsite"
  remote_store = "archive"
  remote_ns    = each.key
  schedule     = "sat 04:00"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `remote` (String) Name of the remote to scan, such as the `name` of a `pbs_remote`.
- `store` (String) Name of the datastore on the remote.

### Read-Only

- `namespaces` (Attributes List) The namespaces, sorted by path, so that each comes after its parent: the root namespace first, when the auth ID may see it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--namespaces))

<a id="nestedatt--namespaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `namespaces`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Comment; null when there is none.
- `ns` (String) The namespace, such as `dept1/hosts`; an empty string for the root namespace, which `remote_ns` of a `pbs_sync_job` takes as left out.
